question_text: Are all federal flood insurance requirements met including minimum ratings?

answer_options.response: Loan approved even though the property is part of the Coastal Barrier Resource System
answer_options.exception_description: The subject property is or is proposed to be located within the Coastal Barrier Resources System.

answer_options.response: No, the SFHDF does not correctly identify the borrowers/subject property address/lender/servicer
answer_options.exception_description: The flood determination (SFHDF) does not correctly identify the borrowers, subject property address and/or current lender/servicer.

answer_options.response: No, property is located in a SFHA and escrows were not established for collection of flood premiums
answer_options.exception_description: Escrow was not established for the collection of flood insurance premiums and fees on behalf of the borrower where the subject property is located in a special flood hazard area.

answer_options.response: The flood insurance deductible requirements as per property type were not met
answer_options.exception_description: The flood insurance deductible requirements as per property type were not met.

answer_options.response: No, the escrow account does not include premiums and fees for payment of the flood insurance policy
answer_options.exception_description: Flood insurance is required and the escrow account established at consummation does not include all premiums and fees for payment of the flood insurance policy.

answer_options.response: No, the Notice of Special Flood Hazard Area was not mailed or delivered to the borrower(s)
answer_options.answer_exception_name: Flood - Notice of Special Flood Hazards
answer_options.exception_description: The Notice of Special Flood Hazards and Availability of Federal Disaster Relief Assistance was not mailed to the applicants within a reasonable time before the completion of the transaction.

answer_options.response: No, the SFHDF fee charged to the borrower exceeds the actual costs + life of loan monitoring fee
answer_options.answer_exception_name: Flood - Standard Flood Hazard Determination Fee
answer_options.exception_description: The fee for the Standard Flood Hazard Determination Form (SFHDF) charged to the borrower was not limited to actual costs of the determination, plus life-of-loan monitoring, where applicable.

answer_options.response: No, a complete and accurate SFHDF was not used to evaluate the loan for flood insurance requirements
answer_options.answer_exception_name: Flood - Standard Flood Hazard Determination Form
answer_options.exception_description: The file does not reflect a complete and accurate Standard Flood Hazard Determination Form (SFHDF) was used to evaluate the loan for flood insurance requirements.

answer_options.response: No, sufficient flood coverage was not in effect as of the date of loan consummation
answer_options.answer_exception_name: Flood - Sufficient Flood Coverage at Consummation
answer_options.exception_description: The file does not contain evidence of sufficient flood coverage in effect as of the date of loan consummation.

answer_options.response: No, the Notice of Special Flood Hazard Area does not contain all required disclosure language
answer_options.answer_exception_name: Notice of Special Flood Hazard Area Content
answer_options.exception_description: The Notice of Special Flood Hazard Area does not contain all required disclosure language in accordance with the model clauses in Appendix A (Rev. 01-01-2016).

answer_options.response: Private flood insurance policy does not meet the definition or include the prerequisite statement
answer_options.exception_description: Where the property is located in a SFHA and a private flood insurance policy is received that a) meets the definition of private flood insurance, or b) includes the following statement within the policy or as an endorsement to the policy: “This policy meets the definition of private flood insurance contained in 42 U.S.C. 4012a(b)(7) and the corresponding regulation.”, the private flood insurance policy was not accepted. [Mandatory on or after July 1, 2019]

answer_options.response: Private flood policy discretionary acceptance requirements were not met
answer_options.exception_description: Where the property is located in a SFHA and a private flood insurance policy issued by a private insurer is accepted in accordance with the discretionary acceptance requirements, the policy was not issued by an insurer permitted under the regulation and/or the policy does not provide a sufficient amount of insurance or cover both the mortgagor(s) and the mortgagee(s) as loss payees.

answer_options.response: Not Applicable
Yes, SFHDF and, if required, federal flood insurance requirements were met

answer_options.exception_description: The HOI information is incorrect

answer_options.exception_description: The HOI worksheet was incomplete or not located in the file.

answer_options.response: The property insurance policy did not provide for claims to be settled on a replacement cost basis
answer_options.exception_description: The property insurance policy did not provide for claims to be settled on a replacement cost basis.

answer_options.response: The deductible for property insurance perils exceeds 5% of the property insurance coverage amount
answer_options.exception_description: The deductible for property insurance perils exceeds 5% of the property insurance coverage amount.

answer_options.response: The property insurance carrier did not meet rating requirements or rating exception requirements
answer_options.exception_description: The property insurance carrier did not meet rating requirements or rating exception requirements.

answer_options.response: Short form cert of property insurance did not show all information and/or not signed by the insurer
answer_options.exception_description: The short form certificate of property insurance provided did not show all necessary information and/or was not signed by the insurer.

answer_options.response: 1-4 unit property insurance not written on a "special" coverage form or equivalent
answer_options.exception_description: The subject 1-4 unit property insurance was not written on a "special" coverage form or equivalent.

question_text: Were all Condo, Co-op, or PUD Projects property insurance requirements met including minimum ratings?
applicability_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Loans.LoanID FROM Loans  WHERE Loans.QC_Policy = 'Fannie Mae' AND (Loans.LoanType = 'Portfolio' OR Loans.LoanType = 'Portfolio DHM' OR Loans.PropertyType = 'Condminium' OR Loans.PropertyType = 'PUD' OR Loans.PropertyType = 'PUD Attached' OR Loans.PropertyType = 'PUD Detached' OR Loans.PropertyType = 'Cooperative' OR Loans.PropertyType = 'Condo')

answer_options.response: The project fidelity/crime insurance policy not in place or had an improper amount of coverage
answer_options.exception_description: The project fidelity/crime insurance policy was not in place and/or had an improper amount of coverage as applicable.

answer_options.response: Unit interior not included in the blanket policy & HO-6 policy not obtained with sufficient coverage
answer_options.exception_description: The unit interior improvements are not included under the terms of the blanket policy; however, an HO-6 policy was not obtained with coverage sufficient to repair the condo unit to its condition prior to a loss claim event.

answer_options.response: The master policy was not written on a broad coverage form that includes the required language
answer_options.exception_description: The master insurance policy was not written on a broad coverage form that includes the required language.

answer_options.response: The master insurance policy does not provide for claims to be settled on a replacement cost basis
answer_options.exception_description: The master insurance policy does not provide for claims to be settled on a replacement cost basis.

answer_options.response: Master policy deductible exceeds the 5% max due to a per unit peril deductible w/out an HO-6 policy
answer_options.exception_description: The master insurance policy deductible exceeds the 5% maximum due to a per unit deductible for named perils specific to a geographic area, without an HO-6 policy.

answer_options.response: Master ins doesn't cover 100% replacement value of project improvements/common elements/residences
answer_options.exception_description: The master insurance policy coverage limit is not at least equal to 100% of the replacement cost value of the project's improvements, including common elements and residential structures.

answer_options.response: Central heat/cool project policy did not include boiler & machine/eqpt breakdown or was insufficient
answer_options.answer_exception_name: Master Project Boiler and Machinery/Eqpt Breakdown
answer_options.exception_description: Centrally heated/cooled project policy did not include boiler and machinery/equipment breakdown coverage equaling the lesser of $2 million or the replacement cost value.

answer_options.response: Policy did not include building ordinance/law coverage or inflation guard coverage as applicable
answer_options.exception_description: The master policy did not include building ordinance/law coverage or inflation guard coverage as applicable.

answer_options.response: NY purch MI not based on state law, using non-co-op appraised value/co-op sales price w/out IPC adj
answer_options.exception_description: The subject New York purchase mortgage insurance determination was not based solely on New York state law, using the appraised value at the time of sale for a non-co-op property or the sales price for a co-op property without an adjustment reflecting excess IPC contributions.

answer_options.response: No evidence of project general liability insurance as applicable or insufficient required coverage
answer_options.exception_description: No evidence of project general liability insurance as applicable or the required coverage amount is not met.

answer_options.response: Replacement cost coverage not met
answer_options.exception_description: Certificate of insurance provided does not meet replacement cost coverage requirements.

Yes, all Condo, Co-op, or PUD Projects property insurance requirements were met
